metadata.sourceSemantics: For reviewed-existing entries, sources name the KORA file whose exact existing output is reused. Empty sources on a candidate mean that no lexical attestation is claimed; corpus provenance is recorded separately.

statusPolicy.attested: Externally attested Adamawa Fulfulde form with a redistributable or citable public source.
statusPolicy.reviewed-existing: Exact output already present in KORA.
statusPolicy.compositional-candidate: Transparent proposal composed from KORA vocabulary; requires native review.
statusPolicy.local-loan-candidate: Locally shaped or technical loan proposal; requires native review.
statusPolicy.preserved-code: Opaque code, API identifier, webhook event, or integration token preserved byte-for-byte in fub.

metadata.warning: The supplied French corpora are terminology inventories, not parallel French–Adamawa Fulfulde corpora. Only entries marked reviewed-existing or attested may be presented as validated; all compositional-candidate and local-loan-candidate forms require Adamawa Fulfulde native-speaker and domain review. No SIL dictionary content was extracted or redistributed.
importantAmbiguities: Remboursement is split by meaning: Ruttinangol kaalisi for a returned merchant payment and Yoɓugol nyamaande for loan repayment.
Crédit can denote lending, an account credit, or airtime; candidates distinguish these senses compositionally.
Règlement can mean payment, settlement finality, or dispute resolution.
Action can mean an equity share or an action required by a workflow.
Provision, franchise, échéance, principal, capture, clearing, settlement, and reversal are domain-sensitive.
Technical English loans and all non-reviewed compounds need regional Adamawa Fulfulde validation.
